title: Flat, finitely presented, complete-intersection fibre at q: locally a relative global complete intersection
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, $\mathfrak q\subset S$ a prime ideal and $\mathfrak p=\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$. Let $F=S\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ be the fibre ring [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and $\mathfrak Q\subset F$ the kernel of the ring map $F\to\kappa(\mathfrak q)$, $s\otimes\lambda\mapsto\bar s\bar\lambda$. Assume (1) there is $g\in S\setminus\mathfrak q$ such that $S_g$ is a finitely presented $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]; (2) the local ring map $R_{\mathfrak p}\to S_{\mathfrak q}$ induced by $\varphi$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]; (3) there is $h\in F\setminus\mathfrak Q$ such that the localization $F_h$ is a global complete intersection over $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field]. Then there are $g'\in S\setminus\mathfrak q$, integers $n,c\ge0$ and $f_1,\dots,f_c\in R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] such that $R[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_c)$ is a relative global complete intersection [def-weil-pbc-relative-global-complete-intersection] and $S_{g'}\cong R[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_c)$ as $R$-algebras ($S_{g'}$ the localization of $S$ at $\{1,g',g'^2,\dots\}$, an $R$-algebra via $R\to S\to S_{g'}$).
